_doc: Hub and landmark site prefabs on the walkable globe (SiteBuilders; built by the definition's sites_script). sites: [{id, kind (hub | landmark), name, size_m (pad diameter), clear_core_m (junk-free core, default 12), start_only (true: only hub 0 gets it; the other hubs cycle through the rest), desc}], hubs first. Optional: hub_pad_m (flat pad radius of hubs after the first, default 82), fill_pad (the builder gets the pad's flat radius as opts.flat), yard_keep_out (the start yard keeps junk off its pad piece by piece), api (a note on the script's entry point).
api: AnvilSites.build(site_root: Node3D, site_id, stage 1..5, restoration 0..1) -> Node3D; local +Y up, locally flat patch at the root's origin

sites.name: Foundry Yard
sites.desc: hub base: casting hall, two stacks, conveyor truss and hopper, ore spur, ember slag tip, buried hauler

sites.name: Ledger Foundry Tower
sites.desc: the Ledger's colossal 130 m foundry stack on buttresses, pipes and slag tips

sites.name: Lava Forge
sites.desc: running furnace pouring molten slag down a channel to a pool; ladle crane; cools as restored

sites.name: Ruined Smelter
sites.desc: collapsed smelter hall frame, tipped and spilled pots, a toppled stack; restored as a planted pergola
